label: Phase 7 - Dragon-King Thordan (v1.5)
author: Dylan Luxor edited by Battle Litany

steps.label: Start
steps.note:
Start. Tanks point boss either north or south here. (Pf prefers north)

I recommend both tanks start with tank stance and stand in front. OT can shirk the MT during the exaflare cast.

steps.label: Fire/Ice
steps.note:
All mechanics either have fire or ice swords. Fire = stay out of his hotbox until the castbar finishes.
Ice = stay in hitbox until the castbar finishes.

steps.label: Exaflare's Edge 1
steps.note:
Three exaflares spawn based on the boss (front left, front right, and rear). They each have random directions they will move in. 

This toolbox illustrates the braindead dodge. Party starts near the rear exaflare, respecting in or out.

steps.label: Exaflare's Edge 2
steps.note:
Right before 1st Exas & Ice/Fire resolve, be at the edge of the South Exa ready to JP dodge. (Watch the castbar, & move in as soon as it finishes.).

(The dodge spots will be identical for Fire/Ice, only changing the starting spot.)

steps.label: Exaflare's Edge 3
steps.note:
Right after 1st Exas & Ice/Fire finish cast, move to the center of the South Exaflare.

If the boss is facing north, slightly past the middle of the blue diamond indicates the safespot (or with these markers, inside edge of A/1). Be quick to move on the cast and be precise on moving to the spot - it's tight and being late or off will kill you. Many people prefer sprint here to make it safer, but gigaflare might be tight if doing single move.

(The dodge spots will be identical for Fire/Ice, only changing the starting spot.)

steps.label: Exaflare's Edge 4
steps.note: Right after the move inside & as soon as you see the 2nd set of Exaflares explode around you, *immediately* move directly South to the point between the two Blue diamonds/arena marks. This spot avoids any exaflares.

steps.label: Exaflare's Edge 5
steps.note:
Having dodged twice, feel free to move slightly forward to get in melee range. 

Tanks should pop their 90s here and be wary of aggro. If OT left stance on, shirk to be 2nd in aggro.

steps.label: Tank Movement
steps.note:
Tanks move directly center, forward into hitbox. G1 tank will always break left, G2 tank will always break right following the red line paths in the picture.

steps.label: Tank Movement
steps.note: As the tanks, do not move directly east/west after the exaflare. Go forward into hitbox first incase an exaflare will linger and hit flanks

steps.label: Exaflare's Edge 6
steps.note:
As the middle starts to clear, tanks & the first bait start moving in to prep for triple autos. MT grabs Thordan & rotates towards north.

As the 5th Exaflare explodes, as well as after each major mechanic in the phase, Thordan will target 1st + 2nd in aggro & the closest(incl. Center) player each w/ an auto. More info in Step 11.

steps.label: Exaflare End/Autos
steps.note:
Trinity autos. First in aggro takes dark stacks, second in aggro takes light stacks. Remember these autos are AOE so the three people taking these cannot be on top of anyone else.
G1 dps/healer player first, G2 player second.

For the purpose of this toolbox, the center auto order will be MRH. G1 first, then G2.

steps.label: Autos
steps.note:
Before the second hit, the next player in order gets inside & the previous player runs out. Tanks stay spread.

For the purpose of this toolbox, the center auto order will be MRH. G1 first, then G2.

steps.label: Autos + Swap
steps.note:
Second auto hits, & tanks be ready to swap ONLY WHEN THE CASTBAR begins for the next mech. This will lock the boss and prevent it turning suddenly. MT should drop stance, OT should have stance on.

It's better to get in the habit of MT dropping stance early for a swap, since shirk is too long of a CD to use for all swaps.

steps.label: 1st Akh Morn's Edge 1
steps.note:
Thordan spawns 3 small towers that will each hit w/ 5 Akh Morns (6 on 2nd, 7 on 3rd). These spawn like exaflares, depending on the boss's direction. G1 takes left flank tower, G2 takes right flank tower, and tanks take rear tower.

If an akh morn is 6-1-1ed, it will look like the picture on the right. More detail on this in slide 33.

Thordan's swords will also once again choose Ice or Fire, Dynamo or Chariot.

steps.label: 1st Akh Morn's Edge 2
steps.note:
The first Akh Morn hit coincides w/ Ice/Fire resolving.
Make sure to use 10s mit like addle/feint/rep late into the cast!

steps.label: Autos
steps.note:
After the last hit, have the (new) MT take Thordan and face him away from the party, the (new) OT get away, & the next player in order get inside for autos.

For the purpose of this toolbox, the center auto order will be MRH. G1 first, then G2.

steps.label: Autos
steps.note:
First auto hits, & next player in order gets ready to head in.

For the purpose of this toolbox, the center auto order will be MRH. Group 1 first, then group 2.

steps.label: Autos
steps.note:
Before the second hit, the next player in order gets inside & the previous player runs out. Tanks stay spread.

For the purpose of this toolbox, the center auto order will be MRH. G1 first, then G2.

steps.label: Autos + Swap
steps.note: Second auto hits, & tanks swap after, facing Thordan South to bait Gigaflares. Current MT drop stance, current OT have stance on. Current OT should only voke WHEN THE CASTBAR starts.

steps.label: Gigaflare's Edge 1
steps.note:
Starting from a random sword, Thordan will bait three proximity Gigaflares in a triangle Clockwise or Counter-Clockwise, whilst also showing Ice or Fire. Simply make sure you're Inside/Outside Thordan's ring across from the coming Gigaflare, & get ready to mitigate.

Go directly across first gigaflare spawn. Get ready to move in the direction opposite of where the second one spawns (CW in this case, or left facing the boss). Or if easier, towards where the third one spawns.

steps.label: Gigaflare's Edge 2
steps.note:
Be ready to mitigate as each Gigaflare begins to go off, moving in the direction needed to dodge all 3.(CW in this case)

THE ICE/FIRE WILL RESOLVE AT THE SAME TIME AS THE FIRST GIGAFLARE! Make sure you are barely inside the hitbox if it's ice - going too deep in will kill you to the proximity damage.

steps.label: Gigaflare's Edge 3
steps.note:
As the first Gigaflare & Fire/Ice goes off, the party should start moving & healing to the next safe spot. Make sure to use 10s mit like rep/addle/feint late into the cast!

NOTE: the party might opt to do single move instead, where you simply run into the first gigaflare after it goes off. I highly recommend saving sprint for gigaflare if doing this. You MUST be max melee when 2 and 3 go off!!

steps.label: Gigaflare's Edge 4
steps.note: The second Gigaflare goes off, party continues moving & healing after to the final safe spot.

steps.label: Gigaflare's Edge 5
steps.note: As the last Gigaflare goes off, tanks need to get ready to re-position Thordan & start taking autos, along w/ the next player in line.

steps.label: Autos
steps.note:
Following the Gigaflares, the party will have a moment to reposition for the next pair of autos.

MT points boss AWAY from party, either north or south. OT should be next to MT here to open flanks and rear.

For the purpose of this toolbox, the center auto order will be MRH. G1 first, then G2.

steps.label: Autos
steps.note:
First auto hits, & next player in order gets ready to head in.

For the purpose of this toolbox, the center auto order will be MRH. G1 first, then G2.

steps.label: Autos
steps.note:
Before the second hit, the next player in order gets inside & the previous player runs out. Tanks stay spread. 

For the purpose of this toolbox, the center auto order will be MRH. G1 first, then G2.

steps.label: Autos
steps.note:
Second auto hits, & tanks swap after 
ON THE CASTBAR, keeping Thordan faced south or north for next mechs.

steps.label: Loop
steps.note:
After the Post-Gigaflare Autos, the entire Phase(Mechs, Autos, & all) will loop, starting again from Exaflares, with each Akh Morn's Edge adding an extra hit (6 on next loop). The looping will halt after the autos following 7-Hit Akh Morn's Edge, beginning Morn Afah's Edge, the Enrage sequence.

Some notes - alternative 6-1-1 facing and towers is covered in the last slides. Also, if using 90s mit on akh morn 2, do it early (during second trinity auto) so its back up for akh morn 3!

steps.label: Morn Afah's Edge 1
steps.note:
After the Phase loop finishes the 7-Hit Akh Morn's Edge, Thordan will do 2 more autos, & then make three towers whilst beginning to cast Morn Afah's Edge.

Somewhat like TEA, this enrage requires each tower to be soaked by one person, but faster, preferrably the 3 lowest in DPS to start. Be ready to move in & take the next hit in each "tower", as any missed hits wipe the raid early like Akh Morn's Edge.

steps.label: Morn Afah's Edge 2
steps.note: The next 3 lowest DPS must *quickly* move in to take the next hit as the previous 3 die.

steps.label: Morn Afah's Edge 3/Enrage
steps.note: Since there are no longer enough players to take all 3 hits, just burn the boss as long as possible before the "missed" towers explode as the Ultimates Enrage.

steps.label: 6-1-1 Towers
steps.note: If doing 6-1-1, the left flank tower will be the 6 soak. The kitchen sink tank soaks right flank tower, and invuln tank soaks rear tower.
